changed_in.5.4: A fourth argument, `lax`, is added. A true value lifts the limit on what a byte sequence may decode to, accepting anything up to `0x7FFFFFFF`; malformed and overlong sequences are refused either way. The default reading also became stricter at the same time: a sequence encoding a surrogate, `0xD800` through `0xDFFF`, now ends the count, where earlier versions counted it like any other character.
